description: Every open perpetual futures position on every connected exchange account: side, size, entry, mark, open profit or loss, leverage, the liquidation price with how far away it is, and the trade plan left on it (set_position_plan_close_or_notify_later). Use first in a new session, and before closing, adjusting a stop or reporting exposure. Not for resting orders or stops (use get_my_open_orders). No inputs. Sizes in the base coin, prices in USD. Next: close_perp_position_reduce_only or get_my_open_orders.
